S1037.reason: The investor succeeds to the buyer’s right to specific performance, and notice of the seller’s breach does not constitute unclean hands.

S0107.reason: Ratione personae immunity protects particular high-ranking officials for both private and official conduct while in office.

S0341.reason: An adult’s normal resting respiratory rate is generally 12–20 breaths per minute, which includes 14–16.
